## Scope

Describe the bounded change and the contracts it affects.

## Validation

- [ ] `gofmt -l .` returns no files
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes
- [ ] Synthetic-only and no network/external process behavior
- [ ] Third-party source, binary, or license changes disclosed
- [ ] DCO `Signed-off-by` included

## Safety

State path, integrity, side-effect, and failure-mode implications.
